title: Point&click game with opus 5.5
author: DearObjective4053
selftext:
I made my Monkey Island x Grand Budapest Hotel game a bit bigger. 

A while ago I posted a tiny demo on Reddit. I actually got a couple of DMs of people playing it so I kept building.

It’s now a prologue + 6 chapters. There’s a floor nobody talks about, a room nobody makes a sound near, and a concierge who knows everything (allegedly).

Made with Opus 5.5, and connectors like image 2.5, Seedance and ElevenLabs. Free, plays in your browser, works on your phone.

Play here: [https://hotel-pomeranz.pages.dev](https://hotel-pomeranz.pages.dev)

![video](8f86xc3v1t0i1 "Teaser trailer (also made by OPUS)")

Tell me where you get stuck, and if you make it to the end, post your time! And AMA about the process, very happy to share how I did this.

comments.body: u/DearObjective4053 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.
